qualificationTarget.scope: complete local unilateral withdrawal preparation through serialized transaction emission

hardware.hybridTopology: 6 performance cores with SMT plus 8 efficiency cores

threadPolicy.rule: Use all 20 online logical CPUs and record the effective worker count and CPU affinity for every run.

method.coldDefinition: fresh prover process with no generated proof artifact reuse; explicitly record whether filesystem cache was flushed
method.warmDefinition: same pinned binary and worker policy after one discarded warm-up run
method.rssMethod: process-tree peak RSS using /usr/bin/time -v or an equivalently pinned process-tree monitor
requiredMetrics: median, p95, maximum, and failure rate

interpretation: This is a pinned consumer mobile-workstation-class research host, not a minimum supported machine. It makes the current under-60-second gate testable; broader hardware support remains a later qualification dimension.
